parameters.content:
## Before you schedule any renders
1. In **Enter shot list, rates and cap**, replace the sample with your project, USD spending limit, USD-per-output-second prices and shots. No credentials or services are required.
2. Give each shot a unique ID, a preset (768P or 2K), a length from 4–15 seconds and the maximum number of billed takes **including the first take**.
3. Execute the workflow. The sample budgets three shots at $2.6136 under a $3 cap. To test the hold branch, lower the cap to $2.60.

## Reading the estimate
The pricing node lists first-pass cost, retake allowance, total and remaining budget. The true branch emits one item per shot. An invalid row or an over-budget batch goes to **Hold** as one item. Fix the input and run again. Re-running calculates the same plan and creates no render jobs.

Sample rates are from [Qianliu’s MiniMax-H3 price table](https://www.plusapi.cn/pricing?keyword=MiniMax-H3), Hailuo-2 group, checked 26 Nov 2026. The maintainer operates Qianliu. Use your own current prices. This estimate covers text-only video billed by output seconds. References, taxes, duration differences and unplanned retries can change the invoice.
